title: PacStudent
description: A custom 2D arcade recreation of classic Pac-Man developed in Unity with C#, built entirely from scratch without relying on Unity's built-in physics or rigidbodies. Features procedural symmetrical 4-quadrant maze generation, grid-based lerp navigation, custom particle effects, and classic arcade mechanics.
Highlights: Custom grid-based movement and input buffering system implemented entirely through mathematical lerping without Unity physics or rigidbodies
Procedural level generator building a full symmetrical 4-quadrant maze from a 2D integer matrix with automated sprite rotation and corner tiling
Dynamic arcade gameplay loop managing countdown sequences, high scores, life tracking, bonus cherry spawning, and power pellets
Custom audiovisual feedback featuring particle systems for movement dust, wall collisions, and death animations alongside synchronized sound effects
